items.html: *Now, each of these ten Sefirot was certainly comprised of all ten Sefirot; but the matter was in a mixture — as if we were to give you an analogy of water and wine and oil and honey and milk and the like, mingled together and placed in a single vessel. And the seven lower ones were in the discernment of judgments. And the reason is that the existence of the world and its governance are impossible without judgments and shells, that is, by means of the work, in the secret of “one opposite the other.” And as it is written in the Mishnah: to exact payment from the wicked, etc., and to give a good reward to the righteous.
